Good to know

Your Throughline
questions, answered.

Do I need a Throughline account?

No. Entries are stored on your device. Make a backup if you want to protect your history when changing or losing a phone.

Does Throughline provide medical advice?

No. Throughline is a personal health record. It does not diagnose or treat conditions, and patterns in your entries are not proof of a medical cause.

How do I get help with Throughline?

Email info@digitalsprout.org with your device, app version and a description of the issue. You can also visit our support page.
